literal: He who does not kill, flesh (acc.) him who has refused, having folded hands, all living beings will worship.
translation: All living creatures will fold their hands and worship the one who never kills and refuses to eat meat.
modern: ஓர் உயிரையும் கொல்லாதவனாகவும், புலால் உண்பதை மறுத்தவனாகவும் வாழ்பவனைக் கைகூப்பி எல்லா உயிர்களும் வணங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme virtue of non-violence and abstaining from meat. It states that a person who neither kills nor consumes flesh earns the ultimate reverence of the natural world. All living creatures will instinctively recognize such a person's compassion and bow to them with folded hands. The act of folding hands signifies deep respect and gratitude from the animal kingdom towards their protector.
